# Tax Documentation: Submit W-8IMY Tax Documentation Data

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`POST /account-owners/{id}/tax-documentation-data/w-8imy` · tenant-scoped token

Submit W-8IMY tax documentation data for an account owner. This endpoint allows you to collect and store W-8IMY form information for foreign intermediaries and flow-through entities.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | No | The Name of the intermediary receiving income on behalf of others. |
| `country` | string | No | Country identifier — an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or one of the supported IRS-only codes (for example `FQ`, `WZ`) or territory names (for example `BURMA`, `SVALBARD`) used where the IRS code collides with an ISO alpha-2 for a different country. See the enum for the full list. One of 272 values: see [values/country-of-citizenship.md](../values/country-of-citizenship.md). |
| `tax_classification` | string | No | The federal tax classification for W-8IMY forms. One of: `QUALIFIED_INTERMEDIARY`, `NONQUALIFIED_INTERMEDIARY`, `TERRITORY_FINANCIAL_INSTITUTION`, `US_BRANCH`, `WITHHOLDING_FOREIGN_PARTNERSHIP`, `WITHHOLDING_FOREIGN_TRUST`, `NONWITHHOLDING_FOREIGN_PARTNERSHIP`, `NONWITHHOLDING_FOREIGN_SIMPLE_TRUST`, `NONWITHHOLDING_FOREIGN_GRANTOR_TRUST`. |

| `permanent_address.state_or_province` | one of several shapes | No | The state or province (US state, Canada province, or other) |

Example request body:

```json
{"name":"Intermediary Co","irs_version":"2021_OCT","country":"GB","tax_classification":"QUALIFIED_INTERMEDIARY","us_tin":"98-7654321","ftin":"FTIN123456","reference_numbers":"REF123456","ftin_not_legally_required":false,"has_signed_and_certified":true,"signature_timestamp":"2023-12-08T15:30:00Z","fatca_classification":"ACTIVE_NFFE","box_39":true}
```

**Response 201**: W-8IMY submission created successfully

Returns the submitted body under `data`, plus:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
